noun_definition: Workspace refers to a collaborative environment created by a user that can have a custom avatar and can be managed by admins, such as deleting the workspace.
Workspace avatar refers to the custom image or representation associated with a workspace that is expected to remain unchanged when an admin deletes the workspace.
Default refers to the standard or original avatar that the workspace reverts to when an admin attempts to delete the workspace, instead of retaining the custom avatar set by the creator.
admin refers to a user who has been promoted to a higher level of access and control within the workspace, allowing them to perform actions such as deleting the workspace.
